cases.query: What is Q-EdgeAttention designed for?
cases.answer: Q-EdgeAttention is an asymmetric non-uniform INT4 quantization framework designed specifically for embedded ARM Cortex-M55 cores with Ethos-U55 microNPUs to enable deploying large transformer architectures onto resource-constrained edge microcontrollers [Research Paper.pdf, p. 1].

cases.query: Why is Hessian-weighted second-order error minimization applied?
cases.answer: Hessian-weighted second-order error minimization is applied during post-training quantization (PTQ) to preserve attention entropy without requiring extensive retraining [Research Paper.pdf, p. 2].

cases.query: Why does the low-oil-pressure alarm trip automatically?

cases.query: explain the connectivity setup
cases.answer:
To set up the physical connections for the DHT-11 sensor, follow these steps:

1. Connect the GND pin on the right side (marked with a "–") to ground [DHT11 Notes for the Students.pdf, p. 1].
2. Connect the middle pin to Digital Pin 5 [DHT11 Notes for the Students.pdf, p. 1].
3. Connect the leftmost VIN pin to 5 V [DHT11 Notes for the Students.pdf, p. 1].

cases.query: What is Step 1 of immediate containment and evacuation?
cases.answer: Step 1 is to immediately alert all occupants, evacuate the contaminated zone, and post biohazard hazard perimeter warning tape at a minimum distance of 5 meters from the spill boundary [Biohazard Sop.pdf, p. 1].

cases.query: What occurs during a primary cloud region outage?
cases.answer: During a primary cloud region outage, DNS routing automatically redirects edge ingress to the secondary hot-standby region using Route 53 health checks [Telemetry Arch.pdf, p. 3]. This automated failover achieves a recovery time objective (RTO) of under 4 minutes and a recovery point objective (RPO) of zero data loss for acknowledged Kafka batches [Telemetry Arch.pdf, p. 3].

cases.query: Walk me through the neutralization steps and the disposal procedure.
What is the pre-start sequence for the compressor before opening variable inlet guide vanes?
cases.answer:
Before opening the variable inlet guide vanes, the compressor start-up sequence involves keeping the oil sump heater energized for at least 8 hours, followed by three numbered steps and an automated pre-lube purge cycle [Tech Manual.pdf, p. 3]:

1. Open condenser isolation valves and start cooling tower pump CW-P1 [Tech Manual.pdf, p. 3].
2. Start chilled water distribution pump CHW-P1 and verify water flow switch FS-101 closes [Tech Manual.pdf, p. 3].
3. Switch the main control selector switch from STANDBY to AUTO on panel CP-4, prompting the microprocessor controller to execute an automated 90-second pre-lube purge cycle [Tech Manual.pdf, p. 3].

cases.query: Explain the stream processing and storage architecture.
cases.answer:
Stream processing is orchestrated by Apache Flink clusters running on dedicated Kubernetes node pools, which compute real-time anomaly scores using 5-minute tumbling windows and 30-second sliding sub-aggregations [Telemetry Arch.pdf, p. 2]. 

The processed telemetry is routed into two primary datastores: TimescaleDB for sub-hourly operational dashboards and ClickHouse for historical time-series analytics [Telemetry Arch.pdf, p. 2]. The architecture is designed to maintain a P99 ingestion latency from edge generation to ClickHouse query availability of under 250 milliseconds under a peak load of 250,000 events per second [Telemetry Arch.pdf, p. 2].

cases.query: what is troubleshooting frm thw source
cases.answer:
For troubleshooting, the source instructs you to download the following .ZIP files from the given locations and install them:

* **DHT Sensor Library** [DHT11 Notes for the Students.pdf, p. 1] (https://github.com/adafruit/DHT-sensor-library) [DHT11 Notes for the Students.pdf, p. 1, p. 2]
* **DHT-sensor-library-master** (Available at https://github.com/adafruit/Adafruit_Sensor) [DHT11 Notes for the Students.pdf, p. 2]
* **Adafruit_Sensor-master** (Available at https://github.com/adafruit/DHT-sensor-library) [DHT11 Notes for the Students.pdf, p. 2]

You must copy these .ZIP files into your Arduino/Library directory, open the Arduino IDE, go to **TOOLS > INCLUDE LIBRARY > ADD ZIP Library** to extract and install them, and then deploy the program [DHT11 Notes for the Students.pdf, p. 2].
